summary: Deterministic identity projections for Quick Dev router; PLAN_ID toolchain-workflow-repair; slices W0-W6; reject absolute, parent-traversal, symlink, excluded logs/ and state files; hash file bytes with sha256; canonical JSON uses UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators; repository root and plan paths derived from file location; contract must match plan ID and contain slice list; unknown or missing slices invalid; flatten allowed/planned paths, ignore wildcard strings; tools/ paths resolve under plan tools directory; candidate manifest deduplicated and path-sorted; dependency identities include dependency candidate hashes; predicate includes selected slice, contract, registry, candidate; authority and validator path sets are fixed; outputs candidate, predicate, authority, validator, closure, and validator hashes plus version; snapshots expose per-slice or aggregate hashes across W0-W6.
